apps.name: Quillsong
apps.tagline: Books that turn like paper and read aloud
apps.description: A book reader with lifelike page turns and two pages side by side on the tablet. Opens PDF, EPUB, Word and text files, and reads them aloud in a natural voice that works offline, even with the screen off, highlighting each word as it goes.

apps.name: Gambit
apps.description: Chess with tournament boards, matching backgrounds, chess clocks and a computer opponent with six levels.
